otherHeat: Its own heaters, pump and controller (set by hand)
notes: A 65 L Brewzilla (Fritz, 2026-11-07, Rule 5.39): it heats and pumps itself and Skynet does not switch any of it. Built in: its 4 switches (the bottom drain Pump, Heater 1, Heater 2, Heater 3), its temperature set point and screen with its On/Off button and Run spot (a Manual vessel Widget, Brewzilla_Controls), the silver BSP spigot on its outlet (Brewzilla_Spigot) and the Manual valve on the out side of its pump (Brewzilla_Pump_Out). A Process sets them and a pop-up asks you to do it by hand; its screen goes back to °C every time it is turned off, so a set point in °F is given in °C too.
